source.label: A lagged restoring flow lightens tails

reviewer: Claude Code with sole fresh-context medium reviewer

claims.summary: Simulation, N = 16*4^J uniform points, J = 6, 7, 512 seeds each: the dyadic flow corrected after each level j >= 1 by circulations exchanging the means of sibling level-j squares inside their level-(j-1) parents (coordinate 1 vertically, coordinate 2 horizontally), amplitudes by damped Newton descent on the quartic cost of both coordinates of the running field, has per-point exceedance fractions, each position standardized over the seeds, of 0.566 and 0.563 (coordinate 1) and 0.481 and 0.460 (coordinate 2) of the dyadic flow's at 2.2 standard deviations, and 0.115 and 0.128, 0.089 and 0.070 at 3.3 (J = 6, 7); with the dyadic flow's analytic spread, 0.044 and 0.014 (coordinate 1), 0.349 and 0.391 (coordinate 2) at 3.5; variance ratios 0.78 and 1.23. Lighter in shape than a Gaussian of those variances (ratios 0.159 and 3.44 at 3.5) and than the simultaneous rule (0.245 to 0.364 at 3.3 in the same normalization). A difference at two sizes; its change with J undecided.
claims.assessment: Finite check, expectations committed before the run; controls passed: zero amplitude gives the dyadic field exactly, no pair's quartic cost rose, global averages agree, a planted lighter law seen; a divergence control added after the review shows the correction divergence-free (weak form, ratio 0.0), its positive control failing its committed threshold (0.066 to 0.100 against 0.2; the separation from 0.0 read post hoc). Thresholds stop at 3.5 standard deviations; a third size was not run.
claims.rationale: A flow with per-point tails lighter in shape than the dyadic flow's and than the simultaneous rule's in the same normalization, outside thm:square-mean-flow-obstruction under the natural assignment of steps and nonlinear in the counts. In a two-value model of one exchange its amplitude is the linear rule (R - B)/3 at zero parent mean for every strictly convex even cost, and nonlinear in the parent mean for the quartic; additivity fails in one exchange of the script's own map (amplitudes -0.404, 0 and -0.508 for child means (2,-2), (1,1) and their sum (3,-1)).
claims.next_action: Run the push measurement of ex:rule-conditional-pushes on the lagged flow; then measure the lightness against the threshold t at fixed J, and regress the amplitudes on (R - B)/3, the parent mean and the spread.

relationships: The paired drift, whose corrections stay in their own level's squares, amplified; the lagged flow's change the means of the squares whose information they use.
The descent pays the lemma's leg in its choice.
Same normalization and thresholds; the lagged flow's ratios at 3.3 are two to five times lighter.
Its hypothesis fails for the lagged flow under the natural assignment of steps; other decompositions not excluded.
